title: When the Parish Burns
author: Jonah Reyes
blurb: August Oyelaran, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has spent ten years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the tide gives up what it took.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
